source.text: ወከመዝ፡ አዘዘ፡ እግዚአ፡ ለነገሥት፡ ወብሁዛን፡ ወለልዑላን፡ ወለእለ፡ *የኀድሩ፡ ለምድር፡ ወይቤል፡ አንሥኡ፡ አዕይንቲክሙ፡ *ወአንሥኡ፡ አቅርንቲክሙ፡ እመ፡ ትክሉ፡ አእምሮቶ፡ ለኅሩይ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: Thus the Lord commanded the kings, the mighty, the exalted and those who dwell on earth: “Lift up your eyes and raise your horns, if you can recognize the Chosen One.”[a]

footnotes.text: The selected second object is your horns, not a silently substituted forehead, head or brow. The command is plural, and the if-you-can qualification and Chosen One title are retained without supplying a later personal identification. The body spelling of the mighty-group term requires an independent exact glyph check.

source.text: ወአንበሮ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈስት፡ ዲበ፡ መንበረ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ ወመንፈስ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ተክዕወ፡ ዲቤሁ፡ ወነገረ፡ አፉሁ፡ ይቀትል፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ኀጥኣነ፡ ወ*ኵሎሙ፡ ዐማፅያን፡ እምገጹ፡ ይትኀጐሉ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: The Lord of Spirits seated him on the throne of his glory. A spirit of righteousness was poured upon him, and the word of his mouth will kill all sinners. All the unjust will be destroyed from before him.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected pouring verb is passive and is controlled by the primary pouring entry. His throne/glory/mouth and the final before-him relation are retained; the English does not identify those pronouns by an unprinted personal name. The killing and destruction clauses are both present.

source.text: ወይቀውሙ፡ *በይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ነገሥት፡ ወብሁዛን፡ *ወልዑላን፡ ወእለ፡ ያአኅዝዋ፡ ለምድር፡ ወይሬእይዎ፡ ወይአእምርዎ፡ ከመ፡ ይነብር፡ ዲበ፡ መንበረ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ ወጽድቅ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ይትኬየን፡ ወነገረ፡ በከ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይትበሃል፡ በቅድሜሁ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: On that day all the kings, the mighty, the exalted and those who hold the earth will stand. They will see him and recognize that he sits on the throne of his glory. Righteousness is judged before him, and no empty word is spoken before him.[a]

footnotes.text: Holding the earth uses the primary seize/hold range, not an additional political office. The selected righteousness-plus-judging expression is not silently rewritten as he judges righteously; its precise construction and the final empty-word relative need further review. Both before-him phrases and the negative no-empty-word are retained.

source.text: ወይመጽእ፡ ዲቤሆሙ፡ ሕማም፡ ከመ፡ ብእሲት፡ እንተ፡ ውስተ፡ ማሕምማ፡ [ወያዐጽብ፡ ወሊድ]፡ ሶበ፡ ወልዳ፡ ይመጽእ፡ በአፈ፡ ማሕፀን፡ ወትዐጽብ፡ በወሊድ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: Pain will come upon them like a woman in labor, with childbirth causing distress, when her child comes to the opening of the womb and she suffers in childbirth.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected bracketed childbirth/distress clause is included in meaning rather than silently removed. The text describes the opening, literally mouth, of the womb, not a new medical mechanism. The childbirth comparison follows the actual pain/womb/distress vocabulary; exact attachment of the bracketed doubled birth term remains uncertain.

source.text: ወይሬኢ፡ ወኒርቁሙ፡ ለመኒርቁሙ፡ ወይደነግፁ፡ ወያትሕቱ፡ ገጾሙ፡ ወ*ያአኅዝዎሙ፡ ሕማም፡ ሶበ፡ ይሬእይዎ፡ ለዝኩ፡ ወልደ፡ ብእሲ፡ እንዘ፡ ይነብር፡ ዲበ፡ መንበረ፡ ስብሐቲሁ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: One will look at another; they will be terrified and lower their faces. Pain will seize them when they see that Son of Man sitting on the throne of his glory.[a]

footnotes.text: One looking at another is a provisional interpretation of the unusual repeated ወኒርቁሙ/ለመኒርቁሙ sequence; it is not replaced by a familiar reciprocal phrase in the source. Primary terror, lowering, face and pain senses support the rest. The selected Son of Man is retained without adding an identity.

source.text: ወይባርክዎ፡ ወይሴብሕዎ፡ ወያዐብይዎ፡ ነገሥት፡ ወብሁዛን፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ *ያአኅዝዋ፡ ለምድር፡ ለዘይመልክ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘኀቡአ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: The kings, the mighty and all who hold the earth will bless, praise and magnify him who rules over everything hidden.[a]

footnotes.text: The blessing, praising and magnifying share a him object, followed by the one who rules all hidden things. No later personal name is supplied for that referent, and holding the earth is kept distinct from the rule-all-hidden-things clause.

source.text: እስመ፡ እምቅድመሰ፡ ኅቡእ፡ ኮነ፡ ወልደ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ወዐቀቦ፡ ልዑል፡ በ*ቅድሜሁ፡ ኀይሉ፡ ወከሠቶ፡ ለኅሩያን።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: For the Son of Man was hidden from the beginning. The Most High kept him before him in his power and revealed him to the chosen.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected wording puts before-him next to his-power in an unusual construction. In his power is provisional, not an adopted added preposition. The Son-of-Man expression and the Most High are both retained without collapsing their printed relations. From the beginning and the chosen recipients remain explicit.

source.text: ወይዘርእ፡ ማኅበረ፡ *ኅሩያን፡ ወቅዱሳን፡ ወይቀውሙ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ *ኵሎሙ፡ ኅሩያን፡ በይእቲ፡ ዕለት።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: He will sow the assembly of the chosen and the holy, and all the chosen will stand before him on that day.[a]

footnotes.text: The printed sowing verb is rendered sow, not silently replaced with gather or establish. Assembly has primary association/congregation support; the seed/assembly image is left as the selected metaphor. All the chosen and that day are retained.

source.text: ወይወድቁ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ነገሥት፡ ወብሁዛን፡ ወልዑላን፡ ወእለ፡ ይመልኩ፡ ለየብስ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ በገጾሙ፡ ወይሰግዱ፡ ወይሴአሉ፡ ለዝኩ፡ ወልደ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ወያስተበቍዕዎ፡ ወይስእሉ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ምሕረተ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: All the kings, the mighty, the exalted and those who rule the dry land will fall on their faces before him. They will bow down, petition that Son of Man, plead with him and ask him for mercy.[a]

footnotes.text: The long plural subject is included rather than dropping a group between fall and on-their-faces. Charles printed113 note13 regards the intervening group list as syntactically suspicious; this proposal retains the selected edited sequence without deleting it. Petition/plead/ask-for-mercy are distinct printed verbs, and no unprinted recipient is supplied.

source.text: ወየጐጕኦሙ፡ ውእቱ፡ እግዚአ፡ መናፍስት፡ ከመ፡ ይፍጥኑ፡ ወይውጽኡ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ወ*ገጾሙ፡ ይመልእ፡ ኀፍረተ፡ ወጽልመት፡ ይትወሰክ፡ ገጾሙ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: That Lord of Spirits will drive them to hurry away from before his face. Their faces will be filled with shame, and darkness will increase over their faces.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected urging/driving verb is controlled by the primary hasten/urge range. Shame fills their faces, and darkness increases; the text is not turned into a new punishment mechanism. Before his face and their faces are separate possessive relations.

source.text: ወ*ይመጥውዎሙ፡ ለመላእክት፡ ለመቅሠፍት፡ ከመ፡ ይትፈደዩ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ዘገፍዕዎሙ፡ *ለጻድቃን፡ ወለኅሩያን፡ ዚአሁ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: They will hand them over to the angels of punishment to exact repayment from them for oppressing his righteous and chosen ones.[a]

footnotes.text: The source gives an anonymous plural they-will-hand-over; this proposal does not replace it with a singular named Lord as agent. Exact repayment follows the primary requital sense. His righteous and chosen ones occur at the end of the cross-page unit and are not omitted.

source.text: ወይከውኑ፡ አርአየ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ *ወለኅሩያን፡ ዚአሁ፡ ቦሙ፡ ይትፌሥሑ፡ እስመ፡ መዐቱ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መናፍስት፡ ይኄይስ፡ ዲቤሆሙ፡ ወመንገለቱ፡ እምዲቤሆሙ፡ ተሰክረ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: They will become a spectacle for his righteous and chosen ones, who will rejoice over them, because the wrath of the Lord of Spirits rests upon them, and his sword is drunk from them.[a]

footnotes.text: Spectacle and the intoxication metaphor have primary lexical support. The selected wrath predicate and the exact sword phrase require further form/syntax confirmation; rests is provisional, not an adopted reported reading. The righteous/chosen recipients and the rejoicing relation are retained without an added instruction to later readers.

source.text: ወጻድቃን፡ ወኅሩያን፡ ይድኅኑ፡ በይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ወኢገጾሙ፡ ለኀጥኣን፡ ወለዐማፅያን፡ ኢይሬእዩ፡ እምድኅረዝ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: The righteous and the chosen will be saved on that day, and from then on they will no longer see the faces of sinners and the unjust.[a]

footnotes.text: Both selected negative elements in the face/seeing expression are preserved as a single natural English no-longer relation, not treated as a positive. The source does not add an explanation of whether the condemned cease to exist; the statement concerns what the saved will see.

source.text: ወእግዚአ፡ መናፍስት፡ ዲቤሆሙ፡ የኀድር፡ ወምስለ፡ ዝኩ፡ ወልደ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ይበልዑ፡ ወይሰክቡ፡ ወይትነሥኡ፡ ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: The Lord of Spirits will dwell over them, and with that Son of Man they will eat, lie down and rise forever and ever.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected preposition is over/upon them, retained rather than silently replaced with among. Eat, lie down and rise form the printed sequence; no extra drinking verb or resurrection date is inserted. The Son-of-Man title is not supplied with a later personal name.

source.text: ወትነሥኡ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወኅሩያን፡ እምድር፡ ወትኄድግ፡ አትሐተ፡ ገጽ፡ *ወለብሱ፡ ልብሰ፡ ስብሐት።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: The righteous and the chosen will rise from the earth; the lowering of the face will leave, and they will put on a garment of glory.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected lowering-of-face expression is nominal and awkward; the proposal does not turn it into an unprinted singular person ceasing to be downcast. Rise-from-earth and put-on-a-garment-of-glory are both retained. The tense/subject attachment of the middle clause needs further review.

source.text: ወውእቱ፡ ይኩን፡ ልብስክሙ፡ ልብሰ፡ ሕይወት፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአ፡ መናፍስት፡ ወአልባስክሙኒ፡ ኢይበሊ፡ ወስብሐቲክሙ*ኒ፡ ኢያኀልቅ፡ በቅድመ፡ እግዚአ፡ መናፍስት።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: That will be your garment, a garment of life from the Lord of Spirits. Your garments will not grow old, and your glory will not come to an end before the Lord of Spirits.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected possessive suffixes turn to second-person plural your. This shift is retained, not silently harmonized to their. The primary old/worn sense and the two negatives not-grow-old/not-end are retained. The final title remains Lord of Spirits; no claim of new manuscript attestation is made.

source.text: በአማንት፡ መዋዕል፡ ያስተበቍዑ፡ *ዐዚዛን፡ ወነገሥት፡ እለ፡ ያአኅዝዋ፡ ለየብስ፡ እመላእክተ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ ለእለ፡ ህልወ፡ ምጥዋን፡ ከመ፡ ይሀብዎሙ፡ ዕረፍተ፡ ንስቲተ፡ ከመ፡ ይወድቁ፡ ወይስግዱ፡ በቅድመ፡ እግዚአ፡ መናፍስት፡ ወይትአመኑ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ በቅድሜሁ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: In those days the mighty and the kings who hold the dry land will plead with the angels of punishment, to whom they have been handed over, to grant them a little rest, so that they may fall down and bow before the Lord of Spirits and acknowledge their sins before him.[a]

footnotes.text: The handed-over relation belongs to the punished people, not a new angelic punishment of the angels. A little rest is limited in extent, not pardon or release. Acknowledge their sins follows the selected confession construction and does not insert a claim that the request is granted.

source.text: ወይባርክዎ፡ ወይሴብሕዎ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈስት፡ ወይብሉ፡ *ብሩህ፡ ውእቱ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈስት፡ *ወእግዚኦሙ፡ ለነገሥት፡ *ወእግዚኦሙ፡ ለብሁዛን፡ ወ*እግዚኦሙ፡ ለብዑላን፡ ወ*እግዚአ፡ ስብሐት፡ ወ*እግዚአ፡ ጥበብ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: They will bless and praise the Lord of Spirits and say, “Radiant is the Lord of Spirits, the Lord of kings, the Lord of the mighty, the Lord of the wealthy, the Lord of glory and the Lord of wisdom.”[a]

footnotes.text: Radiant follows the selected starred light/brightness adjective, controlled by primary499–500, not an unmarked change to blessed. Bless and praise remain separate opening verbs. The repeated Lord titles and their kings/mighty/wealthy/glory/wisdom relations are all included.

source.text: ወይብሉ፡ በኵሉ፡ ኀቡእ፡ ኃይልከ፡ ለትውልደ፡ ትውልድ፡ ወስብሐቲከ፡ *ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም፡ ዕሙቅ፡ ውእቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀቡኣት፡ ዘከ፡ ወኅልቈ፡ ኢልቦሙ፡ ወጽድቅ፡ ዚአከ፡ ኅልቆ፡ አልቦ።

Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. translation.text: They will say, “Your power is in every hidden thing from generation to generation, and your glory is forever and ever. All your hidden things are deep and have no number, and your righteousness is beyond counting.”[a]

footnotes.text: The opening your-power/in-every-hidden relation is a provisional construal of the selected order, not an added claim that every mystery is controlled. The repeated generations, forever phrase and both no-number clauses are retained. The precise first predication and the displayed hidden-things inflection need independent review.

source.text: ይእዜ፡ አእመርነ፡ ከመ፡ *ንሴብሕ፡ ወንባርክ፡ ለ*እግዚኦሙ፡ ለነገሥት፡ ወለዘ፡ ይነግሥ፡ ዲበ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ነገሥት።

translation.text: “Now we know that we should praise and bless the Lord of kings, the one who reigns over all kings.”[a]

footnotes.text: The selected know-that construction introduces praise and blessing; should supplies the English relation, not an unprinted claim that they performed it earlier. Lord-of-kings and reigns-over-all-kings remain distinct repeated expressions.

source.text: ወይብሉ፡ መኑ፡ ወሀበነ፡ ዕረፍተ፡ ከመ፡ *ንሴብሕ፡ ወናስተአምን፡ ቅድመ፡ ስብሐቲከ።

translation.text: They will say, “Who will grant us rest, so that we may praise and confess before your glory?”[a]

footnotes.text: The selected give/grant form is read with future force in this question, as the actual printed115 note24 discusses; it is not replaced in the source with a different tense form. The object of confess is not newly supplied as sins in this verse. Your glory remains second person.

source.text: ይእዜኒ፡ ንስቲተ፡ ዕረፍተ፡ ንትመነይ፡ ወኢንረክብ፡ *ንስደድ፡ ወኢንአኀዝ፡ ወብርሃነ፡ እምቅድመነ፡ ኀለፈ፡ ወጽልመት፡ ማኅደርነ፡ ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: “Now we desire a little rest, but we do not find it. We pursue, but do not catch hold. Light has passed away from before us, and darkness is our dwelling forever and ever.”[a]

footnotes.text: Pursue follows the selected starred active pursuit form; no object is invented for do-not-catch-hold. Both negatives are retained. The completed passing of light and the darkness/dwelling claim remain the speakers own statement, not an added narratorial explanation.

source.text: እስመ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ *ኢአመነ፡ ወኢሰባሕነ፡ ለስሙ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈስት፡ [ወኢሰባሕነሁ፡ ለእግዚአ]፡ ወተስፋነ፡ ኮነ፡ ዲበ፡ በትረ፡ መንግሥት*ነ፡ ወዲበ፡ ስብሐትነ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: “For before him we did not believe, and we did not praise the name of the Lord of Spirits; we did not praise him, the Lord. Our hope was in the scepter of our kingdom and in our glory.”[a]

footnotes.text: The bracketed repeated did-not-praise clause is retained in English and source, not silently deleted as an editorially diagnosed repetition. The initial starred form is unusual for the expected first-person plural: we did not believe is provisional and must not be treated as a normalized source spelling. Hope in kingdom-scepter and in glory is retained.

source.text: ወበዕለተ፡ ስራሕነ፡ ወምንዳቤነ፡ ኢያድኅነነ፡ ወኢንረክብ፡ ዕረፍተ፡ ንአምን፡ እስመ፡ ማዕድምነ፡ ውእቱ፡ እግዚአ፡ በኵሉ፡ ምግባሩ፡ ወበኵነኔሁ፡ ወጽድቁ፡ ወገጹ፡ ኵንኖ*ነ፡ ኢይነሥእ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: “On the day of our toil and distress, he does not save us, and we do not find rest. We acknowledge that the Lord is trustworthy in all his works, in his judgment and his righteousness; his judgment does not show us partiality.”[a]

footnotes.text: The selected final face-taking negative is rendered not-show-partiality provisionally, with the first-person-us element retained. The exact trustworthy expression and the relation of his-face/judgment/us require independent lexical and grammatical control. Toil/distress, not-save and not-find-rest are not omitted to smooth the paragraph.

source.text: ወንኀልቅ፡ እምገጹ፡ በእንተ፡ ምግባርነ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ኀጢአትነ፡ በጽድቅ፡ ተኀልቈ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: “We perish from before him because of our deeds, and all our sins have been counted in righteousness.”[a]

footnotes.text: Perish and counted are distinct source roots despite their similar English context. The primary number/count range supports counted. In righteousness is retained without adding a named book or an account not printed here. The plural speakers remain we/our throughout.

source.text: ይእዜ፡ ይብሉዎሙ፡ ተጽግቦ፡ ነፍስነ፡ እምንዋይ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ወኢ*ትከልአ፡ ወወረድነ፡ እምኔሃ፡ ለክብደ፡ ሲኦል።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. Printed stars/brackets retained; raised apparatus reference labels and verse labels excluded, punctuation spacing normalized. Provisional author proposal, not independent manuscript or publication certification.

translation.text: Now they will say to them, “Our soul has had its fill of the wealth of wrongdoing and does not hold back, and we have descended from it into the belly of Sheol.”[a]

footnotes.text: The selected first verb has a them object; the proposal preserves say-to-them rather than silently turning it into they say among themselves. The soul is singular with our suffix. Its wealth/from-it relation and the following withholding negative are not fully resolved. Belly follows the primary internal-organ range; it is not a claim about a mapped physical underworld.

source.text: ወእምድኅረዝ፡ ይመልእ፡ ገጾሙ፡ ጽልመት፡ ወኀፍረት፡ በቅድመ፡ ዝኩ፡ ወልደ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ወእምቅድሜሁ፡ ገጹ፡ ይሴደዱ፡ ወሰይፍ፡ የኀድር፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ማእከሎሙ።
source.note: Actual selected Charles1906 full-page and native400dpi recomposed primary photographs personally collated. translation.text: After this, darkness and shame will fill their faces before that Son of Man. They will be driven away from before his face, and a sword will dwell among them before his face.[a]

footnotes.text: The voice changes to a passive/reflexive driven-away form, controlled by the primary expulsion range. Their faces, his face and among them are not collapsed into a single pronoun relation. The sword dwells among them; the text is not silently rewritten to mean a sword belonging to him or a newly named angel.

translation.text: Thus says the Lord of Spirits: “This is the decree and its judgment for the mighty, the kings, the exalted and those who hold the dry land before the Lord of Spirits.”[a]

footnotes.text: The selected decree/order noun is provisional here, and the following his/its-judgment suffix is not silently dropped. The complete list continues across PDF154→155 and ends before LXIV. Both occurrences of Lord of Spirits are retained; the source is not shortened to a chapter heading.

translation.text: In that place I saw another vision: hidden things.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected word face/aspect can introduce a further vision; primary1209 has the same expression with an explicit64:1 reference. Hidden things is retained as a separate selected expression rather than inventing a new heavenly location. The narrator remains I.

source.text: ሰማዕኩ፡ ቃሎ፡ ለመልአክ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብል፡ እሉ፡ ውእቶሙ፡ መላእክት፡ እለ፡ ወረዱ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ወዘቦአትኩ፡ ኅቡእ፡ ለወልድ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወአስሐትዎሙ፡ ለ*ወልድ፡ ሰብእ፡ ከመ፡ ይገብሩ፡ ኀጢአተ።

translation.text: I heard the voice of an angel saying, “These are the angels who descended to earth and made hidden things enter the children of humanity, and led the children of humanity astray so that they would commit sin.”[a]

footnotes.text: The selected middle verb has an unusual visible form, provisionally rendered made-hidden-things-enter. It is not silently normalized to revealed or taught from another witness. The repeated children-of-humanity expressions and the purpose to-commit-sin are retained. The exact middle form and its relation to the first-person-looking suffix require source and grammatical review.
